packages.summary: QuickJS-ng, a small JavaScript interpreter: qjs file.js, qjs -e "code"
Prettier: formats JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, JSON, Markdown, HTML, YAML and GraphQL
marked: Markdown to HTML (marked notes.md -o notes.html --page)
Spreadsheets: Excel, OpenDocument, CSV and JSON (sheet info|csv|json|make|convert)
PDF files: info, text, merge, pick pages, rotate, pictures or text to PDF (pdf-lib, pdf.js)
Word documents to text, HTML or Markdown (docx text|html|md, mammoth)
FFmpeg: convert, cut and resize video and audio, grab frames (ffmpeg, ffprobe; 32 MB, one thread)
OCR: text from pictures, English (Tesseract 5 via tesseract.js; 7 MB)
